violations.text: The food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils were not sanitized. The required utensil surface temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit (rinse temperature of 180 degrees F) was not achieved during the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher as evidenced by the failure of the thermolabel (temperature indicator) affixed to the surface of a utensil to turn black. Service call placed and 3-bay sink sink must be used to sanitize until dishwasher is reaching proper sanitizing temperature. 3-bay sink set up during inspection. Quat concentration 300 ppm. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2026

The food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils were not sanitized. The required utensil surface temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit (rinse temperature 180 degrees F) was not achieved during the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher as evidenced by the failure of the thermolabel (temperature indicator) affixed to the surface of a utensil to turn black. Service call was placed during inspection and is expected today. 3-bay sink must be used to sanitize until dishwasher is reaching proper sanitizing temperature. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2025

The door to the outside, located in the receiving area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repair has been scheduled for tomorrow. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2025
